blurb: Experience Niagara Falls from several perspectives on a full-day trip from Toronto. Get close to the falls on the optional Voyage to the Falls boat tour, explore Clifton Hill, visit the observation deck, and descend behind Horseshoe Falls on the optional Journey Behind the Falls experience. The mandatory Niagara in-depth route continues along the Niagara Parkway to scenic viewpoints, the Floral Clock, and historic Niagara-on-the-Lake.
